narrative.overview: Avgang is a departure board in a popover. The board is an opaque navy panel taken from Entur's own boards, and it stays dark whatever the system appearance is. Each stop is a block of rows: line badge, destination, platform, time. The only saturated color on the board comes from the line badges and from status (delay, cancellation, disruption). Settings is a plain macOS preferences window with grouped forms and no custom styling beyond the shared badge and chip.
keyCharacteristics: Line colors come from the operator, not from the app.
Rows are separated by hairlines, stops by a darker band.
Every changing number uses monospaced digits.
Native settings that follow the system appearance.

rules.name: The Operator Color Rule
rules.body: A line badge's fill is the operator's `presentation.colour` from Entur, and its text is the operator's `presentation.textColour`. If the operator gives a fill but no text color, the text is white. If the operator gives no fill, the badge uses the Entur mode color (metro #F08901, tram #B482FB, bus and coach #FF6392, rail #42A5F5, water #6FDFFF, any other mode lavender) with board navy text. Never hard-code a line's color in the app.

rules.name: The Status Color Rule
rules.body: Coral means cancelled and canary means late or disrupted. Neither is used for anything else on the board.

rules.name: The Steady Digits Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes over time uses monospaced digits: countdowns, delays, line codes, walking time, distance and the menu bar label.

rules.name: The Realtime Rule
rules.body: A realtime time is white and semibold. A time with no realtime data is lavender, medium weight and prefixed with `ca.`.

dos: **Do** keep the board navy and dark in every system appearance.
**Do** take line colors from Entur's operator data, falling back to the Entur mode colors.
**Do** use monospaced digits for every changing number.
**Do** separate stops with the 6pt band and rows with the 1pt rule.
**Do** use native grouped forms and system colors in settings.
donts: **Don't** use coral or canary for anything except cancellation, delay and disruption.
**Don't** add glass, gradients or translucency to the board.
**Don't** add a title bar or subheading to the board.
**Don't** use em dashes or middle dot or bullet separators in UI text.
